Tuition and Fees For SOE Graduate Programs
Tuition and Fees for SOE Graduate Programs
Tuition Rates
Ancillary Fees
Continuation Policies and Fees
Below are the tuition rates and fees for School of Engineering graduate programs.
Graduate Courses
The 2026-2027 tuition rate for School of Engineering graduate level courses is $1,855 per credit. Undergraduate courses (numbered below 100) are billed at $1,140 per credit.
Some School of Engineering master’s and certificate programs offer scholarships. Tufts alumni, as well as graduates of bridge schools, may be eligible for alumni scholarships. Be sure to complete your application before the submission deadline for full consideration. Learn about scholarships.
Please visit the Student Financial Services website for details regarding the estimated cost of attendance for graduate students.
PhD Programs
The 2026-2027 tuition rate for School of Engineering PhD students is $5,226 per semester.
Full tuition is charged for nine semesters unless the student enters the program with an appropriate master's degree, in which case tuition is charged for six semesters. Please visit the Student Financial Services website for details regarding the estimated cost of attendance for graduate students.
Full-time PhD students within the School of Engineering often receive a tuition scholarship. For information regarding Part-time PhD programs, please visit the School of Engineering’s Part-time PhD Program page.
TEEP Program
The 2026-2027 tuition rate for the online Teacher Engineering Education Program is $440 per credit. The lab fee has been eliminated for the 2026-2027 academic year.
Ancillary Fees for SOE
A Graduate Student Activity Fee is assessed to students in master's and doctoral programs to support the activities of the Graduate Student Council. The 2026-2027 Graduate Student Activity Fee is $31 per semester ($62 per academic year). This fee is not charged to certificate students or students enrolled in fully online programs.
A Student Health Insurance Plan (SHIP) premium is assessed for comprehensive individual medical and mental health coverage. Students have the option to purchase additional coverage for spouses, domestic partners, and children directly through the health insurance carrier. Students who are admitted full-time and part-time students registered for seven (7) or more credits in residential (including hybrid) programs are automatically enrolled in SHIP. Students enrolled in fully online programs are not eligible for SHIP. The insurance may be waived if proof of outside comparable coverage from a US carrier is submitted by the deadline. Please visit the Student Health Insurance page for the updated premium for the academic year, as well as the final date for waiving SHIP.
A Student Health and Wellness (SHAW) Fee is mandatory for students who are admitted full-time, and part-time students registered for seven (7) or more credits in residential (including hybrid) programs. This fee covers the use of Tufts Health Service, Counseling and Mental Health Service (CMHS), the Center for Awareness, Resources, and Education (CARE), and Health Promotion and Prevention (HPP), all on the Medford/Somerville campus. Students enrolled in fully online programs are not charged the SHAW fee, and are not eligible for services at Health Service, CMHS, or CARE. Please visit the SHAW webpage for updated per-semester charges.
Continuation Policies and Fees for SOE
All School of Engineering graduate students will be charged continuation tuition for each semester after the tuition requirements for the program have been satisfied. The 2026-2027 continuation tuition is $1,200 per semester.
While most tuition rate changes are effective in the fall term each academic year, The Trustees of Tufts College reserve the right to change the tuition or to establish additional fees or charges for special features or services whenever such action is deemed advisable. We will provide the earliest possible notification of changes in tuition and other fees.
